extraction.document_summary: Great Eastern Prestige Life Gold (SGD/USD) is a single-premium life insurance design intended to provide lifetime protection and a legacy. It is described as a “participating whole of life insurance plan” together with a “non-participating term rider that covers both death and terminal illness.” The key value mechanic is a “Multiplier” of the basic sum assured, stated as up to 3.15 times for the SGD plan and up to 3.45 times for the USD plan, with the multiplier expiring at age 85 next birthday unless extended to age 100 via the Multiplier Extender option (with conditions such as no previously approved claims and no current claim applications). The brochure also states a minimum cash surrender value of at least 80% of the single premium from day 1, and notes foreign exchange exposure if USD is not the home currency.
quality_notes: The brochure provides clear high-level mechanics (Multiplier, multiplier expiry/extension, minimum cash surrender value) but does not state underwriting details, exact ages/limits (beyond 85/100 references), or full benefit definitions required for complete extraction.

policies.quick_summary: Single-premium lifetime protection structured as a participating whole of life plan plus a non-participating term rider for death and terminal illness. The brochure highlights a Multiplier of the basic sum assured (up to 3.15x SGD plan / 3.45x USD plan), expiring at age 85 next birthday unless extended to age 100 via the Multiplier Extender. It also states a minimum cash surrender value of at least 80% of the single premium from day 1 (non-guaranteed bonuses may further enhance cash value). Foreign exchange volatility applies if USD is not the home currency. Terms depend on the product summary and policy contract.
policies.eligibility_notes: Multiplier Extender option described as exercisable if utilised before life assured is age 70 next birthday and subject to conditions (no previously approved claims and no current application(s) for a claim under this Policy or other policies/riders issued by the Company on the same life assured).
policies.coverage_term_description: Lifetime coverage against death and terminal illness; Multiplier expires on the policy anniversary when age next birthday equals the multiplier expiry age of 85 unless extended to 100.
policies.bonuses_or_dividends: Participating whole of life insurance plan with non-guaranteed bonuses added on to this plan.
important_caveats: Foreign exchange volatility risk if USD is not the home currency.
